The '''71st Elite Mechanized Assault Group''' was an elite [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] used by one of the splintered factions of the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Civil War]] that erupted in the wake of the Empire's dissolution in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Characteristics==
The 71st Elite Mechanized [[Battle group/Legends|Assault Group]] was outfitted with [[Color/Legends|dark gray]] [[TIE crawler/Legends|century tanks]]<ref name="SWPM" />&mdash;compact assault vessels consisting of a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] linked between two large tank treads. Unofficially called TIE crawlers,<ref name="DB">{{DB|vehicle|tiecrawler|TIE crawler}}</ref> these were equipped to deliver greater damage to enemy units.<ref name="SWPM" /> Modifications included greater defenses and additional layers of armor plating, though at the expense of target accuracy and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] strength.<ref name="SWPM" /> As such, their century tanks were considered the units' pride.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The 71st Elite was therefore able to withstand greater enemy fire on the front lines than the stock century tanks of the [[88th Mechanized Assault Group]].<ref name="SWPM" />

==History==
The 71st Elite Mechanized Assault Group was in existence since at least [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="IHB" />

During the [[Imperial Civil War]] in the wake of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] dissolution in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> an unidentified faction of the fallen Empire used the 71st Elite's century tanks to lead other ground assault forces on strikes against enemy facilities.<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
An 71st Elite Mechanized century tank miniature labeled as a "TIE Crawler"&mdash;another name for the compact assault vehicle&mdash;was featured in the ''[[Ground Assault]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'', released [[November 14]], [[2007]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.tcgplayer.com/db/game_review.asp?AID=2016&PID=28&DBID=4|text=Ground Assault In Stores Now!|archivedate=20100117061457}}</ref>

Although the 71st Elite Mechanized Unit was mentioned to be part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] on the card, the Imperial Remnant technically didn't exist until 12 ABY, with its formation marking the end of the Imperial Civil War that it was mentioned to have participated in.
